name: AWS CLI with Custom Aliases
description: Installs AWS CLI with custom aliases and AWS Toolkit extension

jit.description: Enable Just-In-Time (JIT) AWS CLI configuration using duploctl on container creation. Requires duploctl to be properly configured.

jitAdmin.description: Use admin credentials when configuring JIT. Adds --admin flag to duploctl command.

jitInteractive.description: Enable interactive mode when configuring JIT. Adds --interactive flag to duploctl command.
